capabilities.description: Set the session schematic/scope split; preserves circuit, simulation and measurements

preconditions: Ordinary revision/document guards and retry retention apply
effects: Set the schematic's fraction of the vertical schematic/scope split, from 0.35 to 0.85; default 0.65
Session only; preserved through example load/reset, New, file open and recovery; not saved in schematic files
Preserves graph, electrical state/run/time/charge, history, dirty state, scope visibility, probes, cursors and recorded playback
Native divider drag/keyboard/accessibility and agents use this command; collapsed/unavailable scope and output/sweep panes hide the split but retain its fraction
Native layout completes on a later frame; view.viewport.set reports the resulting drawable area and refits only when following is enabled; this command itself preserves the view
Scope contents scroll when their allotted area is smaller than their controls; fraction is a preference, not a guarantee of minimum pixel size or OS window resizing

errors.when: Missing/null/nonfinite/out-of-range fraction, unknown fields or malformed parameters
Command revision or document generation changed

completion.mode: immediate shared layout preference; native allocation follows asynchronously

mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

discovery.retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.

checks: layout remains session-only across file open
